questions: Is the shaking present when your arms are completely relaxed and resting in your lap?
Does the shaking worsen when you hold a cup of water or perform fine motor tasks like buttoning a shirt?
Do you have a family history of essential tremor?
Are you currently taking any medications, including asthma inhalers, antidepressants, or lithium?
Do you consume more than two alcoholic drinks per day?
Have you experienced recent weight loss, heat intolerance, or rapid heartbeat?
